title: Castile and Aragon announce an alliance, and Castile and Portugal seal an Iberian wedding pact the same day: the three crowns of Iberia stand together
Late in April 1344 Castile intervenes in the Portuguese civil war
source: Trent's account (late April; the exact day isn't given)

title: The Jamāʿa sits. It was called to seize the moment in the north, but with the three crowns allied and the realm still in debt, the sultan turns it to strengthening the crown and paying what is owed
source: Trent's account; the sitting date from checkpoint 1345-01-27

title: The Distribution of Power now favours the ruler: crown power +33% in place of −10%, the estates' satisfaction target lower, a pull toward absolutism
source: checkpoint 1345-01-27; effects from the game files

title: The royal harem enters the customs of the court in place of the aristocratic court, opening the harem laws
source: checkpoint 1345-01-27; effects from the game files
